title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：taxi　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 taxi 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the driver ① took the taxi that no passenger in the station would have counted, and he said the taking was the whole of the day. The ② taxi, meaning the cab itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed uncounted in the book; a taxi, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ taxi in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ taxi at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A taxi, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the driver said the counting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the taxi was the whole of the matter, meaning the fare and not the cab. The ⑥ taxi, meaning the fare and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; taxi, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a cab and a fare. He said the fare is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ taxi had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ taxi of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of counting; taxi, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ taxi I remember is the cab counted in the timetable, which closed in 1977 and is still counted as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ taxi, my mother said in 1979, is the only cab that improves by being counted; every taxi, she said, is a fare that has agreed to look like a cab. She said the fare was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 出租车（指车站里每一辆旁边的那一辆）
B. n. 出租车（指那辆出租车本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the taxi 乘这一辆出租车
D. n. 出租车（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 出租车之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的出租车之事）
F. n. 出租车（指时刻表里写到、被清点的那一辆）
G. n. 出租车、路费（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 路费（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the taxi that no passenger in the station would have counted
The taxi, meaning the cab itself and not the ticket
the taxi at the far platform
the taxi was the whole of the matter
the taxi had become a line in a timetable
The taxi of the whole thing
A taxi, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: take the taxi 意为“乘这一辆出租车”，1970 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯清点的一辆出租车做了一遍。
taxi 意为“出租车”，指那辆出租车本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。
taxi 意为“出租车”，指车站里每一辆旁边的那一辆，每一辆旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
taxi 意为“出租车”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
taxi 意为“出租车、路费”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这辆路费就是那件事的全部。
taxi 意为“路费”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那辆出租车，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
taxi 意为“出租车”，指时刻表里写到、被清点的那一辆，到 1975 年这一辆成了时刻表里的一行。
taxi 意为“出租车之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的出租车之事是一处车站和三个日子的清点。
taxi 意为“出租车”，我记得的是时刻表里清点过的那一辆，1977 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一辆。
taxi 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，出租车是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的出租车。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年那位司机乘了车站里没有一位乘客肯清点的一辆出租车，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（take the taxi）
那辆出租车，指的是那辆出租车本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。（taxi）
那处车站里每一辆出租车旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。（taxi）
最远那座站台那辆出租车，指的是他们留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（taxi）
叔叔说这辆路费就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那辆出租车。（taxi）
1979 年母亲说，出租车是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的出租车。（taxi）
answers: In 1970 the driver took the taxi that no passenger in the station would have counted, and he said the taking was the whole of the day.
The taxi, meaning the cab itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed uncounted in the book.
Every taxi in that station had the same short ticket beside it.
The taxi at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the taxi was the whole of the matter, meaning the fare and not the cab.
A taxi, my mother said in 1979, is the only cab that improves by being counted.
